title: Check
description: A named use of a skill: one call of the resolution function against the skill it names (docs/core/checks.md). Difficulty is a modifier on the target, not a field here.

skillRef.description: Namespaced skill reference: core:skill/<key> or module:<name>/skill/<key>.

key.description: Symbolic snake_case key, unique within the collection.

description.description: What the check does, in one sentence.

opposed_by.description: Optional: the skill the other side rolls in a contest. How the two results compare is not specified yet (docs/core/checks.md).
